name: KolanHook settles expired buy windows at the pool's manipulated spot price
summary: KolanHook, a Uniswap v4 hook owning the ETH/KLN pool, lets anyone settle an expired buy window with accept(id), which reads the pool's live slot0 price and, when the price is out of range, re-adds the escrowed ETH as liquidity at that price and buys back without a price limit. With flash-borrowed WETH the attacker pushed the price, accepted two expired windows, and swapped its KLN back through the misplaced ETH.
notes: The hook is immutable; its later storage writes are users' windows. The seven earlier accept calls were window owners settling their own windows.
Loss is the ETH the hook and its pool position lost net, which equals the attacker's gain; the window owners received KLN as the windows specify.
